question: To prevent inter-area routing loops, OSPF does not allow advertising routing information between two non-backbone areas and allows advertising routing information only within an area or between the backbone area and a non-backbone area. Therefore, each ABR must be connected to the backbone area. A. TRUE B. FALSE

Which of the following statements regarding OSPF packets is false? A. DD packets contain all LSA information and can be used to periodically synchronize LSOB information between neighbors. B. Hello packets are used to discover and maintain OSPF neighbor relationships and also can be used to elect DR and BDR on broadcast and NBMA networks. C. Two routers must send Hello packets at the same interval. Otherwise, they cannot establish an OSPF neighbor relationship. D. DD packets carry LSA header information to describe link state summary information.

Which of the following statements regarding OSPF neighbor relationship and adjacency is true? A. Not all neighbors can establish adjacencies. B. Neighbor relationships are selected from adjacencies to exchange routing information. C. OSPF routers must establish an adjacency before exchanging information. D. Adjacencies are maintained using OSPF DD packet
Which cost types are supported in IS-IS? (Choose all that apply.) A. default B. wide C. ToS D. Narrow
Two Level-1 routers in different areas can establish a neighbor relationship. A. TRUE B. FALSE
Which of the following attributes must be carried in an Update message? A. local-Pref B. MED C. AS_Path D. PrefVal

The Hold time in the Open message sent by BGP Peer A is 90s, while that in the Open message sent by Peer B is 30s. What is the interval for sending Keepalive messages after the two peers establish a connection? A. No Keepalive messages will be sent B. 90s C. 10s D. 30s
BFD control packets are encapsulated in UDP packets for transmission. What is the destination port number of multi-hop BFD control packets? A. 4784 B. 2784 C. 5784 D. 3784

Which of the following statements about the AC's mobility group are false? (Choose all that apply.) A. STAs can roam only between ACs in the same mobility group. B. The mobility server must be an AC in the local mobility group. C. A mobility server needs to be specified for member ACs in a mobility group. D. ACs in the same mobility group encapsulate and transmit roaming information over the DTLS extended tunnel.

Which of the following statements regarding DR/BDR are false? (Choose all that apply.) A. In a broadcast network, DR and BDR must be elected. A broadcast network without a DR or BDR cannot operate normally. B. All DR others establish neighbor relationships with DR and BDR only. C. DR others listen on the multicast address 224.0.0.5. D. DR others listen on the network address 224.0.0.6.

Which of the following statements regarding OSPF AS-External-LSA are true? (Choose all that apply.) A. Net mask is set to all 0s. B. Advertising Router is set as the router ID of an ASBR. C. Link State ID and Advertising Router can uniquely identify an AS-External-LSA. D. Link State ID is set as an address on the destination network segment.

Which of the following statements regarding BGP peer are false? (Choose all that apply.) A. BGP peers exchange link state information. B. A UDP connection must be established before BGP relationships are established. C. BGP routers support automatic neighbor discovery. D. BGP peers must be configured with MD5 authentication.

When a routing policy is used to filter routes, which of the following route prefixes will be denied by the IP prefix below? (Choose all that apply.) [HUAWEI]ip ip-prefix aa index 10 deny 1.1.1.1 24 [HUAWEI]ip ip-prefix aa index 20 permit 1.1.1.1 32 A. 1.1.1.2/16 B. 1.1.1.1/24 C. 1.1.1.1/26 D. 1.1.1.1/32

Which of the following statements is false, based on the following IGMP information on an interface of RTA? A. The IP address of the interface is 192.168.1.1. B. The interval for sending group-specific Query messages is 60s. C. The maximum time for response to Query messages is 10s. D. The IGMP version is IGMPv2.

Which of the following statements regarding OSPF route summarization commands are true? (Choose all that apply.) A. The asbr-summary command is executed in the OSPF view. B. The abr-summary command is executed in the OSPF area view. C. advertise is the default parameter of the abr-summary command. That is, if not-advertise is not specified in the abr-summary command, the advertise parameter takes effect by default, D. not-advertise is the default parameter of the abr-summary command. That is, if advertise is not specified in the abr-summary command, the not-advertise parameter takes effect by default.

See the network shown in the following figure. R1 and R2 run IS-IS, and establish an adjacency. IS-IS is enabled on Loopback0 of R2 but disabled on Loopback3 of R2. The configurations shown in the figure are performed in the IS-IS process of R2. Which of the following statements are true? (Choose all that apply.) A. The routing table of R1 contains the route 10.0.2.3/32. B. The routing table of R1 does not contain the route 10.0.2.3/32. C. The routing table of R1 does not contain the routes 10.0.2.2/32 and 10.0.2.3/32. D. The routing table of R1 contains the route 10.0.2.2/32.
Multiple BGP processes cannot be configured on the same router. A. TRUE B. FALSE

Which of the following statements regarding the MED value in BGP are true? (Choose all that apply.) A. According to BGP route selection rules, the MED value has a lower priority than AS Path, Preferred-Value, Local-Preference, and Origin. B. The default MED value of BGP routes is 0. C. By default, BGP can compare the MED values of routes from different ASs. D. By default, if there is no MED value in routes, the value 0 is used. If the bestroute med-none-as-maximum command is configured, the maximum MED value 4294967295 is used.

Which of the following scenarios is not suitable for deploying interface PBR? A. A core switch needs to forward traffic between the intranet and extranet to an AC device that connects to the core switch in off-path mode. B. A core switch needs to forward the traffic between the intranet and extranet to a security detection device that connects to the core switch in off-path mode. C. A device needs to modify the next-hop IP address for locally originated traffic. D. On an enterprise network with multiple ISP outbound interfaces, each internal network segment accesses the Internet through a particular ISP outbound interface.

A route-policy can have multiple nodes, and each node can have multiple if-match and apply clauses. Which of the following statements are false? (Choose all that apply.) A. The operator between if-match clauses under a node is AND. B. The operator between nodes is AND. C. The operator between if-match clauses under a node is OR. D. The operator between nodes is OR.

STP ensures a loop-free network but has a slow network topology convergence speed, affecting communication quality. RSTP has made some improvements based on STP. Which of the following improvements is not included? A. If a port does not receive configuration BPDUs from the upstream device within four Hello intervals, the switch considers that the negotiation with the neighbor fails. B. The non-root switch running RSTP sends configuration BPDUs at the interval specified by the Hello timerr, which is performed independently by each device. C. RSTP reduces five port states to three port states based on user traffic forwarding and MAC address learning. D. RSTP deletes three port states and adds two port roles.

On a network, some switches are enabled with RSTP and some switches are enabled with STP. What will happen? (Choose all that apply.) A. A Huawei switch changes from RSTP to STP. After the STP-enabled switch is removed from the network, the RSTP-enabled switch can be moved back to the RSTP mode. B. A Huawei switch changes its mode from STP to RSTP. After the RSTP-enabled switch is removed from the network, the STP-enabled switch can be moved back to the RSTP mode. C. STP and RSTP is compatible each other, but the rapid convergence of RSTP is unavailable. D. STP and RSTP calculation are performed independently.
In PIM-DM, which of the following processes are involved in SPT establishment? (Choose all that apply.) A. Prune B. Graft C. Flooding D. State-refresh
Which three transmission modes are supported for IPv4 packets? (Choose three.) A. Anycast B. Broadcast C. Unicast D. Multicast
ICMPv6 messages are classified as error or informational messages. A. TRUE B. FALSE
Which of the following protocols are multi-channel protocols? (Choose all that apply.) A. H.323 B. FTP C. Telnet D. SMTP
As shown in the figure, the stateful inspection firewall forwards the packet because the packet matches the session status of the firewall. A. TRUE B. FALSE
Which command is used to configure the VRRP preemption delay? A. vrrp vrid 1 timer delay 20 B. vrrp vrid 1 preempt-delay 20 C. vrrp vrid 1 preempt-mode timer delay 20 D. vrrp vrid 1 preempt-timer 20
The VRID of the VRRP virtual router is 3 and the virtual IP address is 100.1.1.10. What is the virtual MAC address? A. 01-00-5Е-00-01-64 B. 01-00-5Е-00-01-03 C. 00-00-5Е-00-01-64 D. 00-00-5Е-00-01-03

On the network shown in the following figure, the management VLAN is VLAN 10, and the AP is configured to obtain an IP address on the network segment 10.1.1.0/24 through DHCP. The AP, AC, and AR function as the DHCP client, DHCP relay agent, and DHCP server, respectively. Which of the following configurations for the DHCP relay agent and DHCP server are correct? (Choose all that apply.) A. B. C. D.

Which of the following statements about WLAN roaming are false? (Choose all that apply.) A. APs with which a STA is associated before and after roaming can work on different channels. B. During roaming, the STA sends a Reassociation Request frame containing home AP information to the foreign AP. C. During roaming, the STA sends an Association Request frame containing home AP information to the foreign AP. D. APs with which a STA is associated before and after roaming must work on the same channel.

On an OSPF network, an algorithm is used to prevent loops within an area, but loops may occur between areas. Therefore, OSPF defines a loop prevention mechanism for inter-area routes. Which of the following statements are true about the loop prevention mechanism? (Choose all that apply.) A. An ABR cannot inject Type 3 LSAs that describe routes to a network segment in an area back to the same area. B. Inter-area routes need to be forwarded through area 0. C. Inter-area routes cannot be directly transmitted between non-backbone areas. D. All non-backbone areas must be directly connected to area 0.

On an IS-IS network, an AS can be divided into backbone and non-backbone areas. Which of the following types of IS-IS routers can exist in the backbone area? A. Level-1 B. Level-1-2 and Level-2 C. Level-2 D. Level-1-2
Which of the following values is the default interval at which a device sends Keepalive messages to maintain a BGP connection after a BGP peer relationship is established? A. 10 B. 30 C. 60 D. 180

Route attributes are specific descriptions of routes. BGP route attributes can be classified into four types. Which of the following are well-known discretionary attributes? (Choose all that apply.) A. Community B. MED C. Local_Preference D. Atomic_Aggregate

SIMULATION During BGP route summarization configuration, the ________ keyword can be used to suppress all specific routes so that only the summary route is advertised. The summary route carries the Atomic-aggregate attribute rather than the community attributes of specific routes. (Enter the full name in lowercase.)

A router uses an advanced ACL to filter data. The ACL configuration is shown below. Which of the following statements is false about the configuration? [Huawei] ad 3001 [Huawei-ad-adv-3001] rule permit icmp source 192.168.1.3 0 destination 192.168.2.0 0.0.0.255 A. The ACL denies ICMP packets from host 192.168.1.2 to network segment 192.168.2.0/24. B. The ACL permits IP packets from host 192.168.1.3 to network segment 192.168.2.0/24. C. The ACL is a numbered ACL whose number is 3001. D. The ACL permits ICMP packets from host 192.168.1.3 to host 192.168.2.200.

On an RSTP network, several new protection functions are added, such as root protection, loop protection, and TC BPDU attack defense. Which of the following statements are true about the new protection functions of RSTP? (Choose all that apply.) A. When a designated port enabled with root protection receives RST BPDUs with a higher priority, the port cannot forward packets for a period of time. B. After loop protection is enabled, if the root port does not receive BPDUs from the upstream device for a long time, the root port becomes a designated port. C. After TC BPDU attack defense is enabled, the device processes excess TC BPDUs together only once after the timer expires. D. If BPDU protection is enabled on a device, the attributes of edge ports are affected.

Both the CIST and MSTI are calculated based on priority vectors, which are contained in MST BPDUs. Among the priority vectors that participate in MSTI calculation, which one has the highest priority? A. Internal path cost B. External path cost C. ID of the root switching device D. Regional root ID
The default security zone of Huawei firewalls cannot be deleted, but the administrator can manually change the security priority. A. TRUE B. FALSE

On the campus OSPF network shown in the following figure, the interfaces connecting the five routers are GE interfaces, and their costs are not changed. The import-route command is run on RI. After the network converges, the route to the server at 192.168.1.0/24 is queried on R4. Which of the following is the cost of this route? A. 1 B. 2 C. 3 D. 4

On an MA network, OSPF reduces the number of adjacencies by electing a DR or BDR. Which of the following statements are true about DR or BDR election? (Choose all that apply.) A. If the DR priorities of interfaces are the same, router IDs are compared. A smaller value indicates a higher priority. B. If the DR priorities of the interfaces that directly connect two routers are both set to 0, the two routers cannot establish an adjacency. C. DR or BDR election is preemptive, and the preemption time is 15s. D. DR or BDR election is based on interfaces. A larger DR priority value of an interface indicates a higher priority.

IS-IS and OSPF are both link-state IGPs, but they have some differences. Which of the following statements are true about the comparison between IS-IS and OSPF? (Choose all that apply.) A. IS-IS has higher scalability than OSPF and supports network layer protocols including IPv4 and IPv6. B. IS-IS and OSPF work at different layers. IS-IS works at the data link layer, whereas OSPF works at the network layer. C. Each IS-IS router belongs to only one area. The backbone area consists of Level-1-2 and Level-2 routers. D. IS-IS supports more network types than OSPF.
SIMULATION Compared with OSPF, IS-IS has higher scalability because IS-IS uses the _____ structure to construct packets. (Enter the acronym in uppercase.)

When IPv4 unicast packets are transmitted over Ethernet, their destination MAC address is also a multicast MAC address. If the IP address of a multicast group is 224.0.1.1, which of the following is the corresponding multicast MAC address? A. 01-00-5е-01-01-00 B. 01-00-5е-00-01-00 C. 01-00-5е-00-01-01 D. 01-00-5е-01-01-01

As shown in the figure, VRRP is associated with a BFD session. When a backup device detects a fault through BFD, the backup device immediately assumes the master role after the Master_Down_Timer timer expires. A. TRUE B. FALSE

On an IS-IS network, each device needs to be configured with a network entity title, which consists of three parts, each containing different fields. Which of the following fields are contained in the Area Address part? (Choose all that apply.) A. High Order DSP B. API C. IDI D. System ID
Which of the following parameters are compared during designated port election on an STP network? (Choose all that apply.) A. Peer BID B. RPC C. Local BID and local PID D. Peer PID and local PID

BGP confederations are widely used because they can reduce the number of IBGP connections in an AS. Which of the following statements is false about confederations? A. After a confederation is configured, the original IBGP attributes can be retained. B. A confederation divides an AS into several sub-ASs, and EBGP full-mesh connections are established in each sub-AS. C. After a confederation is configured, the original AS number is used as the confederation ID of each router. D. The ASs outside a confederation still consider the confederation as one AS.
DRAG DROP On Huawei firewalls, the priority of the default security zone cannot be changed. Match the following zones on Huawei firewalls with the default security priorities.

ACLs are a common tool for matching routes. ACLs are classified into multiple types based on ACL rule functions. An ACL can be identified by a number, and the number range for each type of ACLs is different. Which of the following type of ACLs are numbered from 4000 to 4999? A. User-defined ACL B. Advance ACL C. Basic ACL D. Layer 2 ACL

A large enterprise wants to reduce the number of broadcast domains and assign the same VLAN and IP address to a STA each time it accesses the WLAN. To meet these requirements, you can configure the even VLAN assignment algorithm in a VLAN pool. A. TRUE B. FALSE

The following figure shows the 0SPF network of an enterprise and the OSPF configurations of R1. Which of the following statements is false about the network? A. R2 can access the server. B. GE 0/0/1 of R1 cannot accept OSPF packets. C. GE 0/0/1 of R1 cannot send OSPF packets. D. The network segment to which GE 0/0/1 of R1 belongs cannot be advertised.

A node of a route-policy can contain multiple if-match and apply clauses. If a route matches a node, all apply clauses of the node are applied to the route. Which of the following routing information can be modified by configuring the apply clauses? (Choose all that apply.) A. OSPF cost type B. Level of IS-IS routes C. AS_Path attribute of BGP routes D. Cost of routes

Link aggregation is a common network technology. Which of the following are advantages of link aggregation? (Choose all that apply.) A. Increased link bandwidth B. Improved reliability C. Load balancing D. Route backup

On an MSTP network, multiple MSTIs are created on four switches to implement load balancing. After the configuration is complete, the display stp brief command is run on the four switches. The figure shows the command outputs. Which of the following statements is true about the network? A. Ethernet0/0/1 on SW3 is an edge port. B. SW1 is the root bridge of MSTI 1. C. Three MSTIs are created. D. GigabitEthernet0/0/2 on SW2 cannot forward data.

RPF check is an important mechanism in multicast to ensure the correctness and uniqueness of the forwarding path. In normal cases, which of the following routing entries are used to select the optimal route during RPF check? (Choose all that apply.) A. Unicast routing entries B. Multicast static routing entries C. MBGP routing entries D. Multicast dynamic routing entries

After IPsec is deployed on an enterprise network, services are interrupted. The administrator finds that no data flow triggers IKE negotiation. Which of the following are possible causes? (Choose all that apply.) A. Configuration error of an interzone security policy B. A mismatch between the ACL and protected data flow C. An unreachable route D. The IPsec policy is not correctly applied to the related interface

When deploying BFD, you need to adjust some parameters so that it can better detect the network status. Which of the following statements is false about BFD optimization? A. To quickly learn about the network status and performance requirements, you can set the interval for sending BFD packets to the minimum value. B. After a high priority is configured for BFD packets, BFD packets are preferentially forwarded. C. If a BFD session flaps, master/backup switchovers are frequently performed on the application associated with the BFD session. To prevent this, set the WTR time of the BFD session. D. On a live network, some devices switch traffic only when a BFD session changes to the Up state. If a routing protocol goes Up later than an interface, no route is available for switching traffic back, leading to traffic loss. To resolve this issue, configure a delay to compensate for the time difference caused when the routing protocol goes up later than the interface.

VRRP has two versions: VRRPv2 and VRRPv3. Which of the following statements are true about VRRPv2? (Choose all that apply.) A. VRRPv2 is applicable to both IPv4 and IPv6. B. By default, VRRP Advertisement packets are sent at an interval of 1 second. C. VRRPv2 supports authentication. D. The default device priority is 100.

On the network shown in the figure, R1 advertises a BGP route to an EBGP peer. Which of the following statements are true about this process? (Choose all that apply.) A. When R2 receives the route and advertises it to R3, R2 retains the Next_Hop attribute of the route. B. R1 sends only incrementally updated routes. C. The Next_Hop attribute of the route is the source address of the UDP connection. D. The route carries the Origin attribute.

Which of the following statements are true about the Local_Pref attribute in BGP? (Choose all that apply.) A. The Local_Pref value remains unchanged during transmission unless it is affected by a routing policy. B. The greater the value of the Local_Pref attribute, the higher the priority. C. The Local_Pref attribute can be transmitted to all BGP peers. D. The default Local Pref value is 0.
A router performs a lookup in its FIB table for a packet. If the tunnel ID in the matching entry is 0, the packet needs to be forwarded through a tunnel, such as an MPLS tunnel. A. TRUE B. FALSE
Which of the following values is the Reserved/Circuit Type field in the IIH packets sent by a Level-1-2 router on an IS-IS network? A. 00 B. 11 C. 01 D. 10

The following figure shows a campus network. IS-IS is configured on all routers on the network and runs normally. By default, which of the following routers have specific routes on the entire network? (Choose all that apply.) A. R1 B. R2 C. R3 D. R7

On an RSTP network, port roles are optimized to overcome the disadvantages of STP. Which of the following port roles are supported in RSTP? (Choose all that apply.) A. Root port B. Designated port C. Backup port D. Alternate port
In inter-AC roaming scenarios, an AC can function as the mobility server of multiple mobility groups, but can be added only to one mobility group. A. TRUE B. FALSE
On a broadcast IS-IS network shown in the following figure, a DIS needs to be elected to create and update pseudonodes. Which of the following routers is elected as the DIS? A. R1 B. R2 C. R3 D. R4

On a BGP network, locally originated routes may be generated in multiple ways. Which of the following locally originated routes has the highest priority? A. Routes imported using the network command B. Routes obtained through manual summarization C. Routes imported using the import-route command D. Routes obtained through automatic summarization

A large number of external routes are imported to an NSSA of an enterprise’s OSPF network. The customer requires that the number of LSAs in non-special areas be reduced. To meet this requirement, route summarization can be configured on an ABR in the NSSA to summarize the routes corresponding to the Type 5 LSAs translated from Type 7 LSAs. A. TRUE B. FALSE

When using a basic ACL to match routes, you need to configure the rule ID, action, and matching items. Which of the following can be used as matching items in the basic ACL? (Choose all that apply.) A. Source/Destination MAC address B. Source/Destination IP address C. Fragment information D. Time range
By default, the increment of a basic, advanced, or user-defined ACL used for route matching is 10. A. TRUE B. FALSE
An ACL can be used to match routes or data, but cannot be used to match both the IP address prefix length and mask length. A. TRUE B. FALSE
